normalization_plan.reason: Constructor argument only participates in the initialization performed by the MultiSigWallet constructor.
Confirmation threshold argument is consumed by the constructor's required assignment.
Owner address argument is normalized into the owner-management function that writes isOwner/owners.
Replacement owner argument is only meaningful inside replaceOwner's owner swap.
Transaction target argument flows directly into the Transaction struct written by addTransaction.
Transaction value argument flows directly into the Transaction struct written by addTransaction.
Transaction payload argument flows directly into the Transaction struct written by addTransaction.
Transaction identifier is normalized into the confirmation flow that indexes confirmations.
New limit argument is only used to overwrite the dailyLimit state variable.
Amount argument is only consumed by the daily limit arithmetic in isUnderLimit.
Generic loop counter is normalized into the confirmation counting loop.
Local accumulator belongs to the confirmation counting performed by isConfirmed.
Storage pointer local encapsulates the Transaction consumed by the base executor's external call.
Cached confirmation boolean is only used to branch accounting in the daily-limit executor.
Range start argument is only used by the transaction id range helper.
Range end argument is only used by the transaction id range helper.
Pending filter flag is only consumed by transaction counting filters.
Executed filter flag is only consumed by transaction counting filters.
